independenceStatement: This reviewer did not author or modify the reviewed remediation, production UI, or immutable browser collection. The reviewer wrote only the assigned reviewer-report.json and reviewer-report.md and did not touch the prior review attempt, production UI, collection inputs, frozen design artifacts, specifications, task checkboxes, owner artifacts, Git staging, or commits.

buildIdentity.displayScaleBasis: The 1280x760 PNG equals the recorded 1280x760 CSS viewport; this is the browser capture scale and is not a claim about a physical macOS display.

reviewedCollections.role: semantic browser authority and fixed browser screenshot

remediationChecks.check: New Drawing primary glyph uses the approved contrast treatment
remediationChecks.expected: White 16x16 New Drawing glyph on the #6965DB primary surface.
remediationChecks.actual: The leading glyph is visibly white and matches the adjacent white label on the purple primary surface.

remediationChecks.check: Recent rows use flat semantic borders and the deterministic Architecture hover surface
remediationChecks.expected: Flat subtle row borders without browser beveling; Architecture uses the approved Light hover surface.
remediationChecks.actual: The dark right/bottom bevel is absent. Row borders are flat and subtle, and Architecture uses the #F1F0FF hover surface.

remediationChecks.check: Welcome and Recent vertical rhythm matches the approved composition
remediationChecks.expected: The action group, Recent heading/subtitle, row stack, and footer preserve the frozen screen's visual hierarchy and grouping.
remediationChecks.actual: The Recent heading and row stack align with the frozen composition, with the heading grouped to the rows and separated appropriately from the actions.

visualChecks.expected: Recent rows show only name and rootPath; drawing-count and last-opened metadata from the screenshot are omitted.
visualChecks.actual: Only name and rootPath are visible. The approved omission is not treated as a mismatch.

compositionChecks.check: Compact Sidebar and Back controls remain at the far-left top shell layer
Welcome hero, two actions, Recent section, and non-persistent-state note are all present
Primary and secondary action emphasis is visually distinct and faithful
Recent section grouping and row surfaces are visually faithful
No shell region is hidden by an SDK mask

legacyRemoval.control: large textual Pin or Unpin control
persistent normal-state All changes saved strip
Unicode placeholder tree or file icons

maskRationale: The immutable mask declaration contains no masks. HF2-01 Welcome exposes no SDK-owned editor, Library, or Presentation interior that requires masking, so the full shell capture was reviewed.

tolerances.browserGeometryTolerance: ±2 CSS px; owned by the bound collector and not re-proved from the screenshot

rasterOnlyTolerance.scope: collector-owned auxiliary welcome-screen component crop only

findings.description: The remediated New Drawing glyph is white on the purple primary surface and no longer has the prior contrast mismatch.
Recent rows use flat subtle borders, and the deterministic Architecture row displays the approved Light hover surface without the prior browser-style bevel.
The action group, Recent heading/subtitle, row stack, and footer preserve the intended vertical hierarchy with no visible High or Critical mismatch.
The registered omission of drawing-count and last-opened metadata is accepted; only name and rootPath are visible.

unverified: A native macOS package, bundle identifier, native window, physical display scale, native menus, and system dialogs were not reviewed; they are intentionally outside this intermediate browser-only checkpoint.
The recorded capture scale is derived from matching PNG and CSS viewport dimensions and does not establish the physical macOS display scale.

Behavior, persistence, keyboard operation, accessible names, focus-visible, loading, disabled, error, five-row overflow, and legacy counts were not re-proved from pixels; the immutable semantic collector owns those facts.
HF2-05 and the other four HF-2 screens were not reviewed by this single-screen checkpoint.
No product-owner decision was created or inferred because ownerRequirement is NOT_REQUIRED for HF2-01.
nextGate: Proceed with the remaining Phase 5 implementation and HF2-05 checkpoint; HF2-01 requires no intermediate product-owner artifact.
